notes.title: PHOTO MODE
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=yauzvYhj1e4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]Added the Photo Mode
Press "P" to open photo mode
Press "V" to view your screenshots in game
Screenshots taken with the photo mode can be viewed in the game but are also located in " C:\TheShorePictures " on your computer
The Photo mode's interface can be hidden by pressing "H" if you prefer to take the screenshot using steam (default "F12")

Added loading indicator with a few loading screens-

Added Hungarian subtitles
Added Turkish subtitles

Small fixes
Opening the main menu or the photo mode will pause the game
Adjusted rotation for a spawning point in the void
Small IDLE animation tweak for photo mode
Discord button tweaks

notes.title: THE SHORE ANIVERSARY PATCH
notes.content:
THE SHORE ANNIVERSARY PATCH

-New hidden event on the island
-Underwater area expanded

-Brazilian Language added

-Some small grammatical fixes for the English text
-Updated descriptions in the controls menu
-A few collision tweaks nothing noticeable

-Discord link updated.

A year has passed since the release of the shore, we release this update to celebrate, and we thank you for supporting the game so far!  
We have learned lots of things from developing  The Shore.
As this is our first game, i would like to let you all know that more titles are coming this year from us and that's because you helped us to!
All of my games will be Lovecraftian in their own unique way.

Our next title is a lovecraftian CO-OP horror! by the title Eresys,  steampage will be available very soon.
If you would like to help us on this title "follow" our kickstarter page https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eresysthegame/eresys  (page not 100% complete yet)

And the third upcoming title is called Necrophosis a lovecraftian horror with mysteries beyond your understandings ;) more to be revealed about it in the near future. (this is my next artistic title with super weird stuff)

Also our Next lovecraftian horror CO OP game has a steam page!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1918970/Eresys/

notes.title: Hotfix and new content
notes.content:
-Improved performance in various parts of the void
-Audio volume adjustments for music and some narrations 
-Small bug fixes

-Rebalanced most chase encounters and enemies in the void and organic level

-Improved artifact handling
-Running while shooting the artifact has also been improved,  the beam now points correctly at the center
-Minor artifact shooting speed and collision adjustments

-Added a new secret event on the island :slight_smile:
-Added an achievement for participating in the secret event
-fixed few seagulls that were hovering
- also working on more extra content around the lighthouse

notes.title: HOTFIX
notes.content:
-Fixed camera sensitivity reseting
-Fixed the daughter photo reappearing after restarting the game

-Improved and Nerfed "eye room"  , less eyes required in order to proceed

-Changed sprint button on controller To "Left Shoulder button"/ "Left Bumper"
-Improved running and sprinting with the controller
-Added other small Controller support improvements
-From now on playing with a controller should be a more seamless experience, but if you still encounter bugs be sure to report them!

notes.title: 2nd HOTFIX DAY 1
notes.content:
-Fixed issue with SteamVR launching 

-Changed Play button text to "Continue" instead of "Start" once the save files are created
-Added the ultrawide support for the resolutions "3440x1440" and "2560×1080"
-Added the option to invert the Y axis 
-Added the option to disable the subtitles
-Added Option to raise the texture streaming pool beyond the default ammount (use only if textures load incorrectly)

-Fixed a bug where the Protoplasmic abomination wouldnt deal damage
-The player now teleports instantly after killing the Shogoth protecting the artifact 
-The player also teleports instantly after killing the voidsoul sent by the void entity on the bridge
-Andrew has a few more health points
-Fixed a bug where the mask wouldn't appear
-Improved the "head room"
-Nerfed enemies speed and health in the organic level
